preconditions.description: t is an integer between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(x.is_integer() and 1 <= x <= 2**29 for x in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]])
preconditions.description: Each x in the input is an integer between 1 and 2^29 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all((a.is_integer() and b.is_integer() and 0 < a <= 2**32 and 0 < b <= 2**32) or (line == '-1') for line in output_lines for a, b in [line.split() if line != '-1' else []])
postconditions.description: Each output line is either '-1' or two integers a and b such that 0 < a, b ≤ 2^32.

postconditions.expression: all((a ^ b == x and (a + b) / 2 == x) or line == '-1' for line, x in zip(output_lines, [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:]]) for a, b in [line.split() if line != '-1' else []])
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the output is not '-1', then a and b satisfy a ⊕ b = x and (a + b)/2 = x. Otherwise, no such a and b exist.
